notes:
LocalGravity v2.1.0 Release:
- Universal File Attachments: send files of ANY sort (PDF, SQLite, CSV, DOCX, ZIP, code, audio, binaries).
- Automatic Scanned Document Image Extraction: PDF photos (e.g. drink menus, receipts) automatically extracted to disk and streamed to Strata Multimodal Vision (port 8080).
- New inspect_document tool for deep PDF/document parsing and image extraction.
- Web Search Mandate: Autonomous search_web trigger whenever unsure or seeking real-world facts.
- Fixed Stop button responsiveness on mobile & touch screens.
- Fixed macOS / Safari DPI scaling and viewport clipping.
